highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.2 refreshes the m150 release line with upstream Ganesh and Chrome bug fixes.
highlights_body: This servicing release is narrowly focused on bundled-engine maintenance, keeping the 4.150 line current without changing the managed API surface or introducing new migration work.

bullets.lead: The m150 branch picked up another round of upstream fixes
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp 4.150.2 rolls in multiple Chrome m150 bug-fix merges together with additional Ganesh fixes, keeping the packaged renderer current for consumers staying on the 4.150 servicing line.
